$comment: Role x stack -> what to install, with a reason per item.
Distinct from profiles.json, which decides how much the agent is ALLOWED to
do. A loadout decides what it CAN do. A junior on the 'safe' permission
profile still needs React skills; the two axes are orthogonal.
Every item carries `why`. That is the whole point: a junior handed a list of
40 skills learns nothing, and inherits someone else's 3% utilisation rate.
A junior handed 12 skills each with a reason can argue with it.
`extends` composes: base -> role -> stack. Later layers add; an item repeated
in a later layer overrides the earlier `why`, which is how a role sharpens a
`scope` is global or project. `needs` lists prerequisites the resolver checks
but never installs — an env var, a binary, an account.
